changelog.note: 126 (backlog F-duplicate, the owner's decisions of 2026-10-07, DECISIONS 124 and 126): duplicates - an invoice-like document whose normalised invoice number and supplier (tax-number key, else the name) match an earlier document of the same family gets a duplicate:<kind>:<other document> to-do in a worker run; kind = copy (issue date, gross total and currency all equal), variant (one of them differs) or undecidable (one is missing). A pro forma invoice is its own family, so it is never a copy of a final invoice. No AI call and no threshold change; measurements are unaffected (the store is read only in a worker run).

122 (backlog Q-upwork-type, the owner's decision of 2026-10-01, DECISIONS 083; GPT round approved on 2026-10-07): detect_detail.foreign_issuer_pack - a receipt whose issuer is not Hungarian (P(issuer is Hungarian) in the no band of the engine's own issuer question) goes to the foreign invoice pack, as the registry already says (invoice_foreign covers a non-Hungarian business's receipt); the only receipt pack is the Hungarian tax authority's. email.m2_types gains proforma_invoice (backlog F-pro-forma): an attached pro forma invoice is extracted like an invoice. No threshold changed.

120 (the owner's choice of 2026-10-06, silent content errors): band_for native.support = default - JEV's raw support of a Word/Excel fact is read with the existing default Noul band; a no-band answer opens a to-do. No threshold changed; the uncertain band stays without a to-do (uncertain_review false).

092 (the owner's decisions of 2026-10-02 after a trial on real work: 'a to-do below 98%', then 'without the informational fields'): gpt_field_confidence.review_below - on the G path without JEV a field GPT extracted with a token probability below it opens a gpt:low_conf::

to-do, only on the accounting fields (the pack's scored, not informational fields and its high-stakes fields); addresses and other informational fields only show it. A field whose check failed already has its to-do. A run with JEV never gets it, not even on the code's fallback when JEV does not answer. On the 70 golden documents (091 answers) it marks 28 of the 59 accepted ones, 6 of the 13 with an error (5 of the 8 with an error in an accounting field); chosen on the measured documents themselves

091 (the paid measurement of 2026-10-02 on the 70 G-path golden documents without JEV, 0.464 USD; the owner's decisions: 'probability only, 0.98' and 'display only, trial first'): gpt_field_confidence.evidence is empty - the source location no longer caps a GPT field (GPT rewrites values, e.g. 'Hungary' for 'Magyarorszag'; with the caps 19 of 25 wrong fields but 112 of 985 right ones fell below 0.98, without them 15 and 33); failed_check stays 0.5; bands - GPT's own display band (confident from 0.98, check from 0.5), served with the settings for the review's colours and its 'uncertain' filter. Still display only: no to-do comes from it. The threshold was chosen on the measured documents themselves

091 (backlog F-gpt-field-confidence, the owner's decision of 2026-10-02: token probability + code evidence, the weaker counts): gpt_field_confidence - on the G path without JEV a field's confidence is the token probability of its value (measure: joint = the product of the value's token probabilities; min and first are kept for the measurement), capped by the code's evidence: a value not printed on the document (not_found) or printed only next to another field's label (context_rejected), or one that failed its field check (failed_check), is capped at 0.5 (the review's 'check' band). Without a token probability only a cap below 1 is shown. Display only: no to-do comes from it until the band is set after the paid measurement (owner decision). The caps and the measure are starting values, to be set by the measurement

090 (backlog F-gpt-type-check, the owner's decision of 2026-10-02): detect_issuer - a code cross-check of the recognised type against the recogniser's own issuer judgement: a type or detailed type in hungarian_types (it presumes a Hungarian issuer) whose P(issuer is Hungarian) is in the no band of detect.issuer_is_hungarian.<engine> is a to-do (detect:issuer_mismatch:<type>); the type is kept. Only for the engines listed (gpt: its type errors are confident, so the confidence band cannot catch them); band_for detect.issuer_is_hungarian.gpt = gpt_detect. Measured on the saved runs: 1 of the 2 silent GPT type errors caught, 0 of the 99 correct types flagged. The reverse direction (a foreign invoice with a Hungarian issuer) is no contradiction: the form decides there (doc_types invoice_foreign)

089 (GPT email intent without JEV): band_for email.intent.gpt = gpt_intent - the email intent recognised by GPT (processing without JEV) has its own band set, for the same reason as gpt_detect; it starts empty (the default band's values, as for the JEV intent) and is tuned after the paid measurement. Its yes/no signals (P(yes) from the answer's token log-probabilities) use the email.signal band like JEV's

086 (backlog F-jev, K4): band_for detect.doc_type.gpt and detect.detail_type.gpt = gpt_detect - the type recognised by GPT (processing without JEV) has its own band set, because its confidence comes from token log-probabilities, not from a calibrated JEV probability; the set starts empty (the default band's values, as for the JEV detection) and is tuned after the paid measurement
kiszervezés a Python-konstansokból (ROADMAP §1 konfig mint adat); tartalom változatlan

Jev keret-kor 1 (BACKLOG 2): nevesitett sav-keszletek (bands) hivasi helyenkent (band_for), Noul no/uncertain/yes, Choice auto/uncertain/human masodik-opcio ressel; a regi kuszobok (human_max_conf, auto_min_conf_high_stakes, review_flag_p, detect.low_confidence, intent_human_max_conf) a savokba koltoztek, ertek valtozatlan; uj: email.jev_unavailable_route

parent_min_prob a default savban (0.85): bizonytalan tipus mellett a szulo-csalad (registry parent) akkor hasznalhato cimkekent, ha az osszesitett valoszinusege eleri; a route nem valtozik, a szulo a review-payloadba es a jsonl-be kerul
band_for invoice.pick.presence (default sav): a jelenlet-Noul ketoldali savja; valasztott ertek + no-sav / none + yes-sav = review-ok

M3 jelek: email.signal_review (mely Noul-jel igen-savja review-ok: prompt_injection), email.signal_routes (prompt_injection -> human:suspicious, minden mas utvonal ele), band_for email.urgency (default; a Score confidence savja az eval-riportban); a multiple_requests csak merheto jel

tipus-csomagok (BACKLOG 1): az invoice.required es invoice.high_stakes listak a configs/types/<tipus>.json csomagokba koltoztek (ertek valtozatlan az invoice_hu-nal); a policy csak a tipus-fuggetlen savokat es az e-mail utvonalakat tartalmazza

OCR-lanc (BACKLOG 7): ocr blokk - az OCR atlagos szo-bizalma (0-1) es a gyenge szavak aranya ez alatt / folott review-ok (ocr:low_confidence, ocr:low_conf_words); a regi sidecar graded-gate max_low_conf_ratio 0.3-jabol, az elso kozmu-OCR-ek alapjan (mean 0.75-0.85, low 0.12-0.20) lazitva

OCR-eszkalacio (a felhasznalo dontese, handoff 013 §8): escalate_min_mean_conf 0.9 / escalate_max_low_conf_ratio 0.1 - a helyi tesseract-szoveg ez alatt / folott a fizetos Azure DI-re eszkalal (configs/ocr.json escalation); a 49 kozmu-etalon tesseract-jelei 0,81-0,92 / 6-19 %, tehat a tobbseg eszkalal - a kuszob adat, a merés utan finomithato

ocr.escalate_min_mean_conf 0.90 -> 0.93 (a felhasznalo dontese, handoff 015): a 49 kozmu-etalon ujramerese szerint a 0,903-0,920 tesseract-bizalmu 16 szamla 20 mezot veszit a 702-bol az Azure-szoveghez kepest (S 95,6 -> 98,4 %); ezen a korpuszon igy minden szkennelt kozmu-szamla eszkalal (49/49), a kuszob csak jobb szkenneken szamit

047 T1.2: detect_detail.anchor_margin 0.75 - a régi horgony-pontszám (kötelező 1 + támogató 0,25 - kizáró 0,5, 0-2) előnye, amely mellett a kód JEV nélkül dönt a részletes típusról; band_for detect.detail_type = default. Hangolva a régi felismerési etalonon (102 irat, első 1500 karakter): 78 kód-döntés, 0 eltérés a régi címkétől, 24 JEV-hez (tanító példán mért, runs/20260928_t1/)
